finalGate.truthBoundary: Draft preparation only. No final/as-built claim is authorized.

gates.label: Canonical compiler report, ownership manifest and forward package exist and agree
One canonical transaction is committed with strict-noop success
Immutable post snapshot exists, differs from prerelease and matches post QA
Bound live entity/player clearance report passed without mutation
Independent post-release QA reports PASS and ACCEPTED
Paired post media passed, binds post/package/crosswalk, and supplies 13 maps
Atomic database closeout imported every verified registry object
Read-only database publication census passed against the accepted post state

truthBoundary: Frozen requirement language is preserved. Effective state is advanced only by a named passing closeout gate; draft output is not as-built.

requirements.requirement: Generate more detailed maps for every district and major building cluster.
requirements.truthNote: Existing maps are baseline/design evidence, not town-expansion as-built maps.
requirements.acceptance: Post-state district sheets have scale, north arrow, bounds, legend, object IDs, route overlays, source snapshot hash and image SHA-256.

requirements.requirement: Produce one large map of everything.
evidence: Baseline atlas exists; no accepted all-expansion post-state overview exists.
requirements.truthNote: Must span every in-scope district without clipping or silently omitting distant campuses.
requirements.acceptance: One georeferenced overview covers the full accepted feature extent and links every district inset.

requirements.requirement: Create more screenshots of buildings, routes and underground spaces.
evidence: Wave 2 exact-object media is an accepted predecessor.
media-file-verification-audit.json is point-in-time and predates final town expansion.
requirements.truthNote: No current-expansion after screenshots exist because there is no accepted post-state.
requirements.acceptance: Each new object has required exterior, interior, route and defect-revealing views captured from accepted post-state.

requirements.requirement: Report what is in the world and town databases.
evidence: Wave 2 accepted database census is preserved in session-control-manifest.json.
Current expansion has no import ledger.
requirements.truthNote: Report must separate preexisting, retired, superseded, proposed and accepted objects.
requirements.acceptance: Read-only census includes tables, row counts, schema, integrity result, features, observations, media relations and snapshot identity.

requirements.requirement: Match screenshots and floor plans to the exact object in the database.
evidence: Wave 2 predecessor catalog achieved exact screenshot/floor-plan coverage for its accepted objects.
requirements.truthNote: A PNG discovered in a directory is not evidence of an object relationship.
requirements.acceptance: Every relation names object ID, media ID, camera ID, view class, source snapshot, path, dimensions and SHA-256; orphan and ambiguity counts are zero.

requirements.requirement: Build and publish a Sites website showing maps, screenshots, floor plans, database objects and progress.
evidence: Sites version 4 is a healthy predecessor publication at https://mc-fleet-world-atlas.ianwalmsley.chatgpt.site.
requirements.truthNote: The current production site does not prove this town expansion is published.
requirements.acceptance: Exact committed source is saved as a Sites version, deployed to production, owner access checked, root/object/report routes return 200 and Worker logs show outcome ok.

requirements.requirement: Create a highly detailed PM-style PDF covering all evidenced sessions today.
evidence: session-pm-dossier.md is an interim source document.
session-frozen-scope-register.md and this JSON are the frozen-scope closeout spine.
requirements.truthNote: The PDF must not promote requested, researched, designed or modeled work to live status.
requirements.acceptance: PDF renders without broken images/links, includes chronology, WBS, requirements matrix, maps, screenshots, risks, decisions, release ledgers, database report, Sites record and Box verification.

requirements.requirement: Move and verify every new PDF, screenshot, map, report and material in Box.
requirements.truthNote: Connector reachability is PASS but the July 28 handoff is not remotely present/verified.
requirements.acceptance: Final manifest has remote Box path, Box file ID, bytes, SHA-256, uploadedAt and verifiedAt for every required file, with zero missing or mismatched entries.

requirements.requirement: Deep-research city grids and use a written research paper as the engineering source of truth.
evidence: District change controls and engineering sources in this directory.
requirements.truthNote: Research precedents guide original design; named real or fictional examples are not copy targets.
requirements.acceptance: Research paper states principles, citations, chosen standards, rejected alternatives and how they control parcel, street, block and wayfinding decisions.

requirements.requirement: Document future plans and plots like a real development.
evidence: District coordinate schedules and master-plan artifacts.
requirements.truthNote: The future mini-city reservation is now frozen at coordinate-plan level and must remain unexcavated; its detailed parcel/utilities/phasing master plan remains future work.
requirements.acceptance: Development plan includes parcels, setbacks, frontages, roads, utilities, protected reservations, phases, object IDs and future camera/DB placeholders.

requirements.requirement: Use PM management and traceability for every request.
requirements.truthNote: The final closeout must supersede interim status without erasing history.
requirements.acceptance: Every owner request maps to district, state, evidence, blocker, next action and acceptance proof.

requirements.requirement: Correct spacing and legibility so turns reveal understandable places rather than unexplained clutter.
requirements.truthNote: Modeled density is not sufficient; field-of-view and walking evidence are required.
requirements.acceptance: Named arrivals, landmark hierarchy, view corridors, frontage rhythm, corner reveals and route signs pass fixed-camera and normal-walk review.

requirements.requirement: Fill town gaps so the settlement reads as blocks, courts, areas and coherent streets.
evidence: WIP2 scope coverage and infill model
requirements.truthNote: Do not fill protected views, access lanes or future utility reservations merely to increase density.
requirements.acceptance: Block-face plan shows continuous but varied frontage, explicit courtyards/service gaps, protected views and complete walk network.

requirements.requirement: Standardize tunnel profiles, junctions, finishes, signage, lighting, drainage and access control.
evidence: Accepted Raven Rock S1 and T2b predecessor engineering documents
requirements.truthNote: The new owner tunnel is a separate modern system and must not inherit the T2b identity.
requirements.acceptance: Tunnel standard schedule defines clear width/height, floor, wall, ceiling, lighting interval, junction language, drainage, refuge, egress and camera stations.

requirements.requirement: Make every stair and stairwell easy to walk.
evidence: WIP2 includes normal-walk stair/headroom roles in several modeled scopes.
requirements.truthNote: Block roles do not prove bidirectional normal walking.
requirements.acceptance: Every stair has consistent rhythm, adequate headroom, landings, guard edges and two-direction normal-walk QA without jumping, digging or pathfinding hacks.

requirements.requirement: Create a dedicated modern owner tunnel that is explicitly not T2b.
requirements.truthNote: The 928-block y=-44 corridor and face halo are dry and block-entity-free, but gravity cells require pre-support and no final operations package includes this scope yet.
requirements.acceptance: Final route has independent object/system ID, no T2b reuse or intersection, dry face halo, zero protected block entities, two egress paths and complete access-control/wayfinding plan.

requirements.requirement: Provide high-finish owner rest nodes and extravagant stair/lift circulation.
evidence: Seven frozen rest suites, theater descent, mansion ascent and paired lift standards in the Gilded Raven coordinate schedule.
requirements.truthNote: All selected envelopes and face halos are dry and block-entity-free; exact gravity pre-support and movement testing remain pending.
requirements.acceptance: Dry conflict-free node and ascent envelopes include paired circulation, landing lobbies, refuge/egress, luxury materials, backup stair, lift-core visual language and bidirectional route tests.

requirements.requirement: Keep owner underground movement private, secure, legible and independently escapable.
evidence: Access and egress principles in observatory and pavilion source documents.
requirements.truthNote: Endpoint alignment and access tiers are not yet frozen.
requirements.acceptance: Access matrix, vestibules, emergency bypass, surface muster points, signage and two independent egress routes are modeled and walked.

requirements.requirement: Use extravagant but usable stairs and lifts in the Guild Hall, owner estate, adult theater and owner tunnel nodes.
evidence: Guild Hall WIP stairs are modeled.
Gilded Raven plan defines theater 9 full flights plus one ceremonial flight, mansion 13 full flights, seven-clear stairs, six headroom and adjacent minimum six-by-six lifts.
requirements.truthNote: Grandeur may not reduce headroom, landing depth, redundancy or route clarity.
requirements.acceptance: Each major level has a ceremonial route and an accessible/redundant route, both with complete envelope, lighting, landing, egress and movement evidence.

requirements.requirement: Bring far-flung added buildings, warehouse and cooking school into a coherent compact development.
evidence: Town master planning and MainStreet engineering artifacts.
requirements.truthNote: Do not move accepted objects without exact preservation/retirement records.
requirements.acceptance: Parcel plan and normal-walk review prove useful distances, coherent frontages and no isolated leftover structures.

requirements.requirement: Complete the roads and place homes on one coherent street or on two properly fronted streets.
requirements.truthNote: Front doors, garages and street address orientation must agree.
requirements.acceptance: Roads are continuous, drivable/walkable, signed and connected; every house fronts a named street and has an unobstructed driveway.

requirements.requirement: Attach a garage to every residential house.
requirements.truthNote: R1 detached garages remain historical evidence and require explicit supersession/retirement.
requirements.acceptance: All 18 parent houses have physically enclosed attached connections, usable bays, doors, driveway clearance, route evidence and corrected database relations.

requirements.requirement: Give every large house a four-car or six-car attached garage.
evidence: Engineering schedule proposes two six-car and four four-car candidates.
requirements.truthNote: Classification of remaining houses requires same-moment survey.
requirements.acceptance: Large-house register is complete and each classified large house has counted clear bays, operable doors and turning/driveway evidence.

requirements.requirement: Integrate warehouse and cooking-school/service buildings with the street grid.
evidence: Town siting and MainStreet logistics documents.
requirements.truthNote: Exact relocation/consolidation package is not independently accepted.
requirements.acceptance: Objects have coherent frontage/service access, protected loading, walk routes and non-conflicting parcel envelopes.

requirements.requirement: Create Guest Services with reception/orientation, coworking, food/social functions and outdoor connections.
evidence: Source modelGuestServicesDestination in scripts/generate_town_expansion_r1.mjs; not yet emitted into an accepted operations package.
requirements.truthNote: Model-only validation reports 15 protected kitchen block entities with zero targeted, four broad stairs, two lifts and two remote routes. Selected design snapshot did not contain the planned employee lounge/greenway, so same-moment generation/rebase is still mandatory.
requirements.acceptance: Final generated report preserves all 15 kitchen block entities, reconciles the staff connection to one source state, and proves all public/service/stair/lift/remote-exit paths.

requirements.requirement: Add patios, roof gardens, hot tubs, rooftop pool/bar and separated adults-only wellness/private areas.
requirements.truthNote: The source model reports 45 adjusted dry support positions and 3,813 modeled water cells at latest priority 990, but it has not produced an accepted operations package or independent load-path QA.
requirements.acceptance: Final generated report and independent QA prove dry supports, 3,813 contained water states, secondary containment, safe edges, two lifts/four broad stairs/two remote routes, privacy, cleanup and non-graphic room program.

requirements.requirement: Build a direct Ravensreach-to-rear-MainStreet staff path and employee lounge.
evidence: WIP2 coverage claims a modeled staff path and employee lounge.
B01 review did not find the planned lounge/greenway in its selected snapshot.
requirements.truthNote: The cross-artifact state mismatch must be resolved on one immutable baseline.
requirements.acceptance: Same-moment source contains one coordinated route/lounge design; bidirectional walk, door, lighting, grade and camera evidence pass.

requirements.requirement: Expand the underground warehouse while recovering the full parking footprint.
requirements.truthNote: Wet-state authority, egress and protected-state gates remain unresolved.
requirements.acceptance: Dry contained warehouse, loading/service routes, two egress paths, parking count/geometry and protected inventory checks pass.

requirements.requirement: Create an RV sales/customer district with support, pantry/club and tasteful private adult option if retained.
requirements.truthNote: Design basis only; no live mutation or accepted generator package.
requirements.acceptance: Sales floor, display/turning envelopes, service, egress, food/club support and any age-controlled non-graphic room are complete and independently routed.

requirements.requirement: Move the entire bunker east far enough to restore the complete parking lot.
requirements.truthNote: Competing coordinate bases must be reconciled; WIP coverage is not a release.
requirements.acceptance: One authoritative schedule proves old-object retirement, full new functional rebuild, recovered parking count/footprint and zero package conflicts.

requirements.requirement: Create a high-quality terrain-following road down the mountain side.
evidence: C01 relocation engineering and coordinate schedules.
requirements.truthNote: Independent audit did not accept road/access geometry.
requirements.acceptance: Stationed road has acceptable grade, width, headroom, retaining/drainage treatment, turnouts, portal arrival and bidirectional walking/driving evidence.

requirements.requirement: Move and recess the bunker entrance.
requirements.truthNote: Portal camera and cover proofs are pending.
requirements.acceptance: Recessed threshold, weather/sightline shielding, airlock, wayfinding and two independent egress routes pass.

requirements.requirement: Keep the entire bunker underground with no concrete shell showing.
evidence: WIP2 claims minimum three-block natural cover.
requirements.truthNote: Minimum cover must be proven across the entire shell, not sampled.
requirements.acceptance: Cellwise cover census shows required natural cover on every non-portal shell face; prescribed exterior cameras show zero exposed concrete.

requirements.requirement: Preserve/rebuild the complete bunker program, routes and independent egress.
evidence: Northeast C01 engineering defines 12 broad program rooms.
WIP2 claims two independent egress routes.
requirements.truthNote: No accepted room census, route QA or data migration ledger exists.
requirements.acceptance: Room-by-room old/new crosswalk, capacity, utilities, access control, two egress paths, database migration and matched-media evidence pass.

requirements.requirement: Hide all visible structural blocks in the mountain landscape.
requirements.truthNote: This is stricter than a three-block minimum at selected sample points.
requirements.acceptance: 360-degree exterior view audit, terrain section sheets and block census show no unintended shell exposure, seams or unnatural cliff projections.

requirements.requirement: Recheck, redesign and finish the penthouse on the town building.
requirements.truthNote: Offline target roles include salon, dining, kitchen, library, suite and roof/terrace details; no live result exists.
requirements.acceptance: Complete exterior crown, weather-tight envelope, usable interior program, safe roof/terrace access, skyline views and matched interior/exterior screenshots.

requirements.requirement: Replace the Amsterdam buildings with a longhouse appropriate to the town period.
requirements.truthNote: Replacement must preserve/retire affected objects explicitly.
requirements.acceptance: Period rationale, old/new object crosswalk, complete longhouse structure/program, frontage, courtyard relation, walk routes and media all pass.

requirements.requirement: Create a designed courtyard around the longhouse and civic ensemble.
requirements.truthNote: Court must work as a place, not leftover paving.
requirements.acceptance: Enclosure ratio, thresholds, drainage, rain garden, seating/dais, statue, lighting and through-route evidence pass.

requirements.requirement: Make the library four times as big.
requirements.truthNote: Four-times claim must be stated against a measured baseline gross floor area and usable program area.
requirements.acceptance: Baseline/current area schedule proves at least 4x usable library program with complete stacks, reading, service, accessibility and egress.

requirements.requirement: Add a two-level concrete walk-out patio/terrace from the library down into the pavilion.
requirements.truthNote: Concrete expression and walkability must be confirmed in final materials and route tests.
requirements.acceptance: Two distinct terrace levels, direct library door, pavilion connection, safe edges, drainage, headroom and bidirectional normal walking pass.

requirements.requirement: Build a larger-than-life Guild Hall opposite the library across the pavilion.
requirements.truthNote: Guild wealth is expressed through craft, scale, procession and material hierarchy, not unusable ornament.
requirements.acceptance: Civic composition, five-level program, exterior monumentality, pavilion connection, accessibility, egress, room count, operational routes and media pass.

requirements.requirement: Give the Guild Hall two basement levels, three stories, dormitories, four kitchens, living spaces, theater, lecture hall, dance hall and bar.
evidence: Guild Hall program and WIP2 coverage: two basements, three stories, four kitchens.
requirements.truthNote: Modeled roles must be independently counted as usable rooms; theater/lecture seating must face actual screens/stages.
requirements.acceptance: Level-by-level room schedule, four distinct functional kitchens, dorm beds, living areas, theater, lecture, dance and bar all have clear areas, routes, services and egress.

requirements.requirement: Research and create a guildhouse bar that looks expensively commissioned.
requirements.truthNote: Specialist research is the design basis; no live bar exists.
requirements.acceptance: Bar has arrival sequence, long counter, backbar, booths, service return, storage, wash, lighting, acoustic separation and bespoke material/detail schedule.

requirements.requirement: Blend library, pavilion and Guild Hall into one civic composition and add statues.
evidence: WIP2 claims six garth statues and six pavilion-ground statues.
requirements.truthNote: Independent audit identified overlap risks among pavilion pools/statues/monument/tunnel rooms.
requirements.acceptance: One non-overlapping civic plan preserves the library-pavilion-Guild axis, accessible paths, views and protected underground zones.

requirements.requirement: Make the pavilion grounds more monumental with gardens, pools, statues and civic features.
evidence: WIP2 pavilion, reflecting-pool, civic-monument and fountain scopes.
requirements.truthNote: Hydrology, overlap and supervised-water barriers require independent closure.
requirements.acceptance: Grounds plan has contained water, non-overlapping structures, complete accessible circulation, views, lighting and post-state water-flow QA.

requirements.requirement: Provide a separate library-to-Guild Hall secret tunnel with challenged-materials archive, private adult literature archive and ceremonial room.
requirements.truthNote: Adult archive remains non-graphic; audit flagged sealed/route concerns.
requirements.acceptance: Isolated route, both endpoint vestibules, archives, ceremonial room, access control, egress, headroom, dry envelope and bidirectional walk pass.

requirements.requirement: Keep civilian pavilion/library/Guild tunnels out of the restricted Ravensgate underground volume.
evidence: Independent audit records the planned y-separation as its limited passing finding.
WIP2 reports zero civilian targets in restricted volume.
requirements.truthNote: Offline separation still requires final-source and post-state confirmation.
requirements.acceptance: Cellwise no-intersection proof on final ops and accepted post snapshot shows zero civilian targets in restricted bounds.

requirements.requirement: Make the road to the stadium bigger and more over the top.
requirements.truthNote: Ceremonial scale must preserve grade, drainage and normal walking.
requirements.acceptance: Continuous widened cross-section, foundations, headroom, lighting, landscape, arrival hierarchy and bidirectional route QA pass.

requirements.requirement: Place billboards along the stadium road.
requirements.truthNote: Billboards must aid sequence/wayfinding and avoid road/headroom/view conflicts.
requirements.acceptance: Six or approved final count have foundations, readable faces, safe setbacks, progressive messages and matched day/night cameras.

requirements.requirement: Ensure stadium seating faces a real screen rather than a doorway or blank wall.
requirements.truthNote: Every current/new seating bank needs a ray-tested screen/stage, not merely a screen somewhere in the venue.
requirements.acceptance: Seat-to-screen sightline matrix, obstruction test, prescribed cameras and normal entry route all pass.

requirements.requirement: Make the stadium easy to find.
requirements.truthNote: Map labels do not substitute for in-world wayfinding.
requirements.acceptance: Town departure, each decision point, oasis, island arrival and stadium entrance have visible landmarks/signs confirmed by normal-walk cameras.

requirements.requirement: Build a halfway oasis inspired by Chicago tollway oases.
requirements.truthNote: Inspiration controls bridge-hall/service logic; the result remains original.
requirements.acceptance: Midpoint relation, road access, bridge hall, food/market, panoramic connection, two surface/lift routes, rest/service support and route evidence pass.

requirements.requirement: Build an original mini-bunker at the oasis with a GTA V–evocative feel.
requirements.truthNote: Fictional precedent is mood/program inspiration only; do not copy protected layouts/assets.
requirements.acceptance: Original plan has concealed but discoverable entrance, operations/support program, two egress routes, dry shell, access control and matched exterior/interior media.

requirements.requirement: Make the stadium complex and island read as one coherent destination.
requirements.truthNote: Venue, pier and waterfront interfaces require final non-overlap proof.
requirements.acceptance: Aligned arrival, mall, venue, pier and shoreline axes pass master-plan, sightline and walking review.

requirements.requirement: Add intentional buildings along the pier.
requirements.truthNote: Buildings must have program, doors, service and relationship to the promenade.
requirements.acceptance: Every pier object has named use, complete envelope/interior, accessible promenade frontage, service path, DB object and camera set.

requirements.requirement: Create a researched original amusement pier.
requirements.truthNote: Precedents are not copy targets.
requirements.acceptance: Pier has coherent midway, attractions, queue/egress, railings, service access, water edge safety, lighting and route evidence.

requirements.requirement: Add a Ferris wheel and roller coaster.
requirements.truthNote: Silhouette alone is insufficient; bases, paths, queues and safety envelopes matter.
requirements.acceptance: Both attractions have complete visible structure, foundations, approach/queue/exit, clear envelopes, non-conflicting sightlines and prescribed cameras.

requirements.requirement: Add paired steak and shrimp/seafood houses.
requirements.truthNote: Restaurants require real kitchen/service/dining and waterfront access.
requirements.acceptance: Each has distinct identity, complete kitchen, dining, service/loading, accessible entrance, waterfront terrace if planned and matched media.

requirements.requirement: Align the main district, pier and stadium pedestrian malls/streets.
evidence: Westlight coordinate schedules and WIP2 coverage.
requirements.truthNote: Alignment must be experienced continuously at grade.
requirements.acceptance: One surveyed centerline and continuous walk path connects all three, with widths, grades, landmarks and decision-point cameras.

requirements.requirement: Create a contained crater lake with quay and green space.
evidence: WIP2 claims 1,443 crater-lake columns plus quay/green space.
requirements.truthNote: Active water requires containment and post-state flow proof.
requirements.acceptance: Closed basin, shoreline profile, quay, continuous public edge, drainage/flow QA, safe routes and overview/detail cameras pass.

requirements.requirement: Preserve and integrate the accepted Westlight infinity screen.
requirements.truthNote: New construction may not obscure, conflict with or falsely replace the accepted object.
requirements.acceptance: Final intersection and sightline audits show the accepted screen remains intact, visible and correctly paired with seating.

requirements.requirement: Build paired facing dry and water parks informed by named precedents but original in design.
requirements.truthNote: Independent audit questioned park completeness/hydrology; later coverage must be reconciled.
requirements.acceptance: Both parks have complete attraction lists, entries, queues, service/egress, shared orientation, original forms, and water park has contained-water QA.

requirements.requirement: Extend the road west and integrate it with the crater-lake greenbelt.
evidence: Westward masterplan and WIP2 parkway extension.
requirements.truthNote: Road and public waterfront must not sever one another.
requirements.acceptance: Continuous road, greenway, crossings, headroom, grades, shoreline access and bidirectional route evidence pass.

requirements.requirement: Create Hampton-style medium-density lakeside housing with continuous public waterfront relationship.
requirements.truthNote: Style is a researched influence, not a copy; private parcels may not block the public edge.
requirements.acceptance: Housing type/parcel schedule, street fronts, services, water views, continuous public path and database/media plan are complete.

requirements.requirement: Build two connected, dignified workforce/affordable housing projects centered on useful outdoor space.
evidence: WIP2 claims two projects and one shared court.
requirements.truthNote: Economic program does not lower safety, completeness, dignity or evidence standards.
requirements.acceptance: Two distinct projects, complete units/common spaces, shared court, services, transit/walk links, lighting, egress and representative media pass.

requirements.requirement: Upgrade steward cottages into mini-mansions, including the current cottage.
requirements.truthNote: WIP2 is blocked at this scope by a protected chest; nine retained block entities are also reported.
requirements.acceptance: Protected inventory is preserved, complete residence program and lane access exist, routes pass and old/new database objects are reconciled.

requirements.requirement: Add an architecturally rich adult theater/cabaret with non-graphic programming.
requirements.truthNote: Frozen plan is the non-graphic 168-seat Gilded Raven Theatre House plus five five-person salons and four one-to-one mini theaters. Building/descent are dry and block-entity-free; two nearby beds remain outside all targets and protected.
requirements.acceptance: Final package preserves the beds; builds real stage before seats; verifies 168 main-house seats plus small rooms, five open vomitories, restaurants, age-controlled/privacy vestibules, accessible route, dressing/green rooms, BOH, acoustic shell, two egress paths and matched cameras.

requirements.requirement: Give the adult theater extravagant stairs/lifts and high-end arrival/detail.
evidence: Frozen theater descent and mansion ascent in the Gilded Raven coordinate schedule.
requirements.truthNote: Theater descent is dry with nine 12-rise/24-run flights plus a 6-rise ceremonial flight, seven-clear stairs, six headroom and adjacent six-by-six lift; it is not yet generated.
requirements.acceptance: Ceremonial stair and accessible lift routes are exact-generated, independently pre-supported, connect every listed landing and pass bidirectional normal-walk/lift QA.

requirements.requirement: Maintain a corrected 24-slot public-record-supported DSM campus register and distinguish built, approved and planned status; never infer 45 completed facilities from numbering jumps.
evidence: Owner/PM correction: 24 slots across DSM1-4, DSM5-8, DSM9-13, DSM14-18 and DSM40-45.
WIP2 separately models ten DM01-DM10 halls with forty rows each; that older modeled package does not establish the corrected 24-slot status register.
requirements.truthNote: Slot identifiers and number jumps are not completed-building counts. Existing, approved and planned entries must be individually sourced and labeled.
requirements.acceptance: Machine register contains exactly 24 unique slots with source, status, object relation and no false claim of 45 facilities; any physically modeled hall is independently counted and tied to its own release state.

requirements.requirement: Provide NOC, power/support, 48-bed dorms, aviation and computer-logistics compound.
requirements.truthNote: Warehouse, hydrology and circulation findings remain open.
requirements.acceptance: Each function has named object/bounds, complete usable rooms, access/service/egress and independent room/capacity counts.

requirements.requirement: Create separate 200-seat presentation auditorium and 200-seat cinema with seats facing actual screens.
evidence: WIP2 claims 200 seats in each independent venue.
requirements.truthNote: Counts and sightlines require independent verification.
requirements.acceptance: Two distinct objects each have 200 counted usable seats, actual screen/stage, clear aisles/exits, projection/BOH and seat-to-screen sightline proof.

requirements.requirement: Keep DM10 a normal surface data hall and place a separate InfoBunker-inspired annex.
requirements.truthNote: The annex must remain original and functionally distinct.
requirements.acceptance: Object/geometry crosswalk proves DM10 normal program and separate annex bounds, entries, services, egress and database IDs.

requirements.requirement: Preserve a medium older personal home beside the campus road while the data district grows; add an attached four-car garage, backyard pool/treehouse, fallout shelter, first-floor tasteful non-graphic adult suite/service kitchen/bedroom-viewing salon/private room, and two-room office/lounge.
evidence: Owner/PM frozen-scope correction; data-team survey evidence pending.
requirements.truthNote: The home is an intentional holdout and may not be demolished, absorbed into a campus envelope or visually erased by Phase 0 work. Adult program remains non-graphic.
requirements.acceptance: Fresh survey fixes parent-home bounds and protected contents; attached four-bay garage is physically usable; pool/treehouse/shelter and named rooms are complete; campus road/perimeters preserve access, privacy, views and two egress paths.

requirements.requirement: Tonight, extend district roads and build only construction perimeters, low future-wall/foundation outlines, walkable gates and block-art project billboards for three future precincts.
requirements.truthNote: No completed, roofed, fitted or operational data hall belongs in Phase 0; Sites/maps/PM/Box must label every envelope PLANNED / PHASE 0.
requirements.acceptance: Road continuity reaches all three parcels; perimeters have legible gates; low outlines and billboards exist; interiors remain empty/unbuilt; zero protected/live entities and zero active water/lava are introduced; exact rollback covers every target.

requirements.acceptance: Exactly twelve empty future envelopes, road/gate/perimeter, labeled reserve areas and META ALTOONA — FUTURE CAMPUS block-art billboard are present and reported unbuilt.

requirements.requirement: Continue a coherent district spine beyond all three precincts with future junctions, a green/utility reserve and at least two unassigned future-campus parcels; grade with contour-following terraces and classify water before altering it.
requirements.truthNote: A giant flat slab, exposed vertical cut, blind fluid replacement or road that dead-ends at the third precinct fails the master plan.
requirements.acceptance: Spine and future junctions remain buildable; two unassigned parcels are protected; cut/fill sections show terraced benches, planted transitions and limited retaining edges; every surveyed water cell has a preserve, detention/dam or isolated-drain decision.

requirements.district: Iowa Data District Phase 0 — shared power backbone
requirements.requirement: Build a legible fictional district-energy Phase 0 with one shared switching yard, two independent-looking transmission corridors, one substation yard/reservation per Meta/Google/EdgeBCC precinct, a continuing utility corridor and marked future storage/operations capacity.
requirements.truthNote: The visible hierarchy is a fictional Minecraft master-plan diagram; it must not reproduce or claim real line routes, voltages, protection schemes, controls, entries or security.
requirements.acceptance: Switching yard, two tower corridors, three substations, service roads/clearances/fencing, continuing reserve, operations shell and unfinished storage pads are present; planted/firebreak separation protects holdout home, public courts, staff buildings, pools and detention water.

requirements.requirement: Expand the fictional completed-hall target from the old ten-hall WIP to exactly 24 DSM slots, while keeping public-source built/approved/planned status separate from Minecraft completion state.
evidence: Data-team frozen count control; final 24-hall coordinates and generator report are pending.
WIP2 only models the superseded ten-hall DM01-DM10 program.
requirements.truthNote: Do not freeze the preexisting ten-hall coordinates as the 24-hall solution and do not infer 45 halls from DSM numbering.
requirements.acceptance: Final machine schedule has exactly 24 unique DSM slot IDs in the five controlled groups, each with source-status and Minecraft-state fields; accepted post-state independently proves exactly 24 complete halls and zero phantom range entries.

requirements.requirement: Build an over-the-top owner mega-estate around the observatory.
requirements.truthNote: Independent audit flagged implementation and NBT/interface risks.
requirements.acceptance: Estate preserves observatory function/views, has complete residential/guest/service/landscape program, safe routes and matched media.

requirements.requirement: Expand the owner safe room and shelter.
evidence: Observatory source documents and WIP2 coverage.
requirements.truthNote: Secure program still requires egress and route proof.
requirements.acceptance: Dry secure envelope, life-support/storage program, two independent egress routes, access control and post-state movement evidence pass.

requirements.requirement: Create owner portal rooms/gallery while keeping every portal entirely inactive.
evidence: WIP2 claims eight rooms and zero active portal blocks.
requirements.truthNote: No live activation; NBT/block-state verification is mandatory.
requirements.acceptance: Post-state census proves zero active portal blocks and zero activation materials in prohibited arrangement; all rooms remain accessible and documented.

requirements.requirement: Include owner wellness, pool and tasteful private non-graphic red-room program.
requirements.truthNote: Privacy and non-graphic content boundary applies.
requirements.acceptance: Separated access, acoustic/privacy vestibules, wash/cleanup, safe contained water, egress and non-graphic furnishings/material plan pass.

requirements.requirement: Reserve protected space for a future mini-city.
evidence: Frozen reservation [65,-38,-280,125,-20,-200] in the Gilded Raven source and coordinate schedule.
requirements.truthNote: Selected reservation and face halo are dry and block-entity-free. It is a protected future plan and must not be excavated; only the sales office may be built.
requirements.acceptance: Final model preserves the entire reservation as no-excavation, records its four corners/elevation/program, builds no streets or city rooms, and keeps exact package/protected-state separation.

requirements.requirement: Build a future-city reservations/sales office.
evidence: Founders' Gallery Sales Office [78,-46,-227,106,-33,-204] in the Gilded Raven source and schedule; dry, dry-halo and zero block entities.
requirements.truthNote: Office relation to the owner corridor is frozen; it remains ungenerated and the presentation door beyond it stays sealed/offline.
requirements.acceptance: Office has public/owner arrival, reception, model/map room, parcel sales desks, closing room, records, staff/service, accessible route, egress and future parcel database links.

requirements.requirement: Plan the mini-city like a development with plots, utilities, phases and sales inventory.
evidence: Gilded Raven plan defines a reserved central square, residence/guest court, operations/concierge, dining/recreation, utility plant and future two-route egress/lift program.
requirements.truthNote: No final master plan or saleable parcel inventory exists.
requirements.acceptance: Approved development plan defines blocks/parcels, rights-of-way, utilities, transit, civic space, phases, reservations, object IDs and sales-office inventory relations.

requirements.requirement: Keep every adult-design component tasteful, private, age-controlled and non-graphic.
evidence: Guild/archive, observatory and Worker Town program notes.
requirements.truthNote: Applies to Worker Town adult theater, Concord night court/theater/dance venue, B01 wellness/private areas, owner red rooms and private adult archive.
requirements.acceptance: Programs use non-graphic names/furnishings, privacy/access/acoustic/wash/egress requirements are explicit, and no media contains explicit content.

requirements.requirement: Build a complete compact two-street service town along the data road; unlike the data-hall Phase 0 precincts, Concord is a full-build target.
requirements.truthNote: No coordinates, generated operations or live town exist yet.
requirements.acceptance: Selected parcel survey, complete enclosed/walkable buildings, continuous roads/sidewalks, exact guarded operations/rollback, post-state routes, database objects and matched media all pass.

requirements.requirement: Create an ordinary legible road face with Concord Fuel & General, Concord Community Post, The Last Relay bar, motel sign, planted edge and no blank backs.
requirements.truthNote: The practical frontage reveals town identity without making the adult court explicit from the highway.
requirements.acceptance: Gas, post and roughly 40-seat bar are complete, front-facing, serviced and walkable; gas circulation is separated from the night-court pedestrian core.

requirements.requirement: Make consensual adult nightlife the defining off-shift economy/hobby for neighboring data-center workers, expressed purposefully but non-graphically.
requirements.truthNote: Architecture, stages, furniture, access zoning and service programming communicate the use; no explicit imagery, figures or acts.
requirements.acceptance: Age-control thresholds, privacy, accessible public routes, distinct performer/service routes, wash/toilet support, acoustic control, two-way egress and non-graphic media pass.

requirements.requirement: Build the Concord Motor Lodge with exactly 25 rooms facing the shared court.
requirements.truthNote: Required split is 13 ground and 12 upper rooms, including two same-quality ground-floor mobility analogues.
requirements.acceptance: Independent count proves exactly 25 complete rooms, broad stairs/lifts at opposite ends, lobby/office, manager office/lounge, breakfast, laundry/linen/housekeeping, staff/service and court-facing routes.

requirements.requirement: Build the non-graphic Gilded Raven Annex opposite the motel with exactly 72 main-room seats, three five-seat salons and two single-guest salons.
requirements.truthNote: The annex is a smaller local theater and has no connection to the Worker Town owner tunnel or Ravensgate.
requirements.acceptance: Real stage/proscenium precedes seats; exact seat/salon counts, two balcony tiers, open bowl circulation, restaurants/bar, dressing/green/rehearsal/loading, public discovery route, ordinary signed route and isolated management/service passage pass.

requirements.requirement: Build a separate non-graphic dance/strip-club venue.
requirements.truthNote: The venue is separate from the annex theater and is represented without explicit content.
requirements.acceptance: Age-control lobby, central stage and sightlines, booths, bar, kitchen, coat/toilets, two dressing rooms, green room, wardrobe, office/count, storage, rear loading and egress pass.

requirements.requirement: Provide a marked shift-change shuttle stop, waiting lounge and late-night food/hospitality for data workers.
requirements.truthNote: Worker services are core town infrastructure, not decorative props.
requirements.acceptance: Shuttle/loading area, safe sidewalk, weather-protected lounge, food service and night-lit route connect ordinary frontage to motel/night court without service conflicts.

requirements.requirement: Make the motel and theater face one real shared pedestrianized parking court with planted center walk and separate rear service lane.
requirements.truthNote: Parking, drop-off, pedestrian, service and performer movement must remain legible and non-conflicting.
requirements.acceptance: Marked perimeter circulation, protected center walk, planted islands, accessible-route analogues, direct public entrances, screened but legible service lane and route tests pass.

requirements.requirement: Reserve two graded/landscaped future entertainment parcels with completed sidewalk and utility stubs and an extendable planted turning court.
requirements.truthNote: No temporary clutter or parking may force demolition for future growth.
requirements.acceptance: Two empty protected parcels, future street/utility stubs, landscape/setback controls and database/map planned status are explicit.

requirements.requirement: Fit Concord to terraced terrain, preserve useful drainage and green buffers, and keep theater/club routes isolated from owner corridor, Ravensgate and inactive portals.
requirements.truthNote: No mega-pad, blind drainage, power-yard adjacency or hidden underground cross-connection is allowed.
requirements.acceptance: Terrain/fluid survey, planted benches, detention decision, town/power buffer, zero forbidden network intersections, zero active portal/lava/bubble/aquatic introductions and exact rollback pass.
